methods.name: VFA
methods.description: We trained VFA using the 394 training scans provided by the Learn2Reg Challenge. A combination of mean squared error loss, diffusion regularizer, and Dice loss was used, with the Dice loss incorporating auxiliary anatomical information from the provided segmentation map of each subject.

methods.name: Attention-based feature matching
methods.description: An innovative form of attention that allows prioritizing displacement vectors directly by computing the weighted sum of the vectors in a matrix R using the attention of x, effectively retrieving the displacement of the candidates relative to x based on the feature similarity encoded in the attention map.
